items.title: GrowthBook · v5.2.1
items.summary: ## Security Patch Release 5.2.1 is a patch release on top of 5.2.0 with security fixes and bug fixes. We recommend all self-hosted users update. ### Security fixes - **Docker image:** zlib 1.4 for CVE-2026-85091 (#7732) - **Dependencies:** zod 4.6 for GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, plus next, mongoose, fast-xml-parser, fflate, glob, ddtrace and others bumped to address known vulnerabilities (#7705, #7580, #7704) - **Input handling:** no more super-linear regex backtracking in trailing slash and semicolon checks (#7636) ### Bug fixes - **Experiments:** unlinked experiments can edit traffic and variations again from Make Changes; fixes for funnel in-progress detection, CUPED with low pre-exposure variance, bandit results, and incremental refresh on proportion metrics (#7677, #7670, #7639, #7701, #7610, #7537) - **Performance:** faster `GET /api/v1/experiments` paging; improved idle worker recycling (#7467, #7562) - **UI:** various fixes to results views, popovers, settings and layout (#7574, #7611

items.title: axe-core · Release 4.14.1
items.summary: This patch release contains only bug fixes. Most of them remove false positives, so issue counts will mostly go down: empty-table-header, link-in-text-block, target-size and aria-valid-attr-value (fewer "needs review" results for aria-controls). Two changes can add new issues: - meta-viewport-scale now reports invalid `user-scalable` and `maximum-scale` values. - Elements with `position: absolute` and `fixed` are now placed correctly when axe works out what is on top of what. This can change color-contrast and target-size results in either direction. heading-order now lists the previous heading as a related node; issue counts don't change. If you use `axe.runVirtualRule`, the `after` steps of checks now run, so those results now match `axe.run`. ### Bug Fixes - **aria-valid-attr-value:** don't review aria-controls when the popup exists ([#5408](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core/issues/5408)) ([cfd2ea6](https://github.com/dequelabs/axe-core/commit/cfd2ea6004e681a97eaca8bedd3add1c721

items.summary: ## Highlights **Interleaving Experiments (beta)** - We are the first platform to offer interleaving experiments, which let you test ranking algorithms 50-100x faster than traditional A/B tests. This is a great tool for testing search results, carousels, and news feeds in a wide variety of products and is a critical tool at companies like Netflix, DoorDash, and Airbnb. **Agent API Keys** - New controls to let agents act on your behalf with proper attribution and safety guardrails. Easily restrict which actions agents can do autonomously and use our brand new “Human in the Loop” mode that let agents propose risky changes (like publishing to production) that a human must review and approve in the UI before it is applied. This is available for both our MCP OAuth server and personal access tokens. **Remote Saved Groups** - You can now upload CSVs with millions of ids and use them for feature and experiment targeting without increasing the size of the payload that clients have to download. items.summary: GrowthBook 5.1 includes over 400 commits touching almost every part of the product. Below are some of the highlights. ## Highlights **Contextual Bandits (beta)** - One size doesn’t fit all. Contextual Bandits let you run personalization experiments to find the best performing variant for each group of users. The bandit continuously learns and updates weights as it runs and helps you pick out the signal from the noise. **Saved Learnings** - Document deeper learnings about your users that you’ve discovered through experimentation. Let our agent automatically scan your past tests to get you started or use our new API endpoints and agent skills to build your own workflows around this invaluable data. **Funnel Metrics** - Easily measure funnel completion in your experiments and see where users are dropping off.
